notes.title: Mahokenshi – Patch Notes 3
notes.notes:
Hello Samurai,

Patch 3 is the big one – we introduce several new features and changes as 
highlighted in the accompanying blog “Mahokenshi – The Creator’s Guide”. 

So again – thank you all for your immense support, and we look forward to hear 
what you think of the new features.

Features:

- In mission saving has been added
- Resume mission button has been added to main menu (triggered by 
leaving a mission unfinished)
- Mission-editor ‘mode’ has been added
- Mission-editor Integration with Steam Workshop (Import & Export) has 
been added
- Custom mission browser has been added
- The free DLC “Mahokenshi – The Creator’s Guide” brings 5 brand new 
maps

Optional: 

- Map 1: Defeat The Armored Oni – The basics! Hit the ground running with 
this map showcasing the core of the mission editor.
- Map 2: Run! – Learn how to make the best use of a time-limit in your 
custom missions 
- Map 3: The Oni Archipelago – Marker’s can highlight what enemies to 
defeat or what objectives to defend. In this map you’ll learn how to get 
creative with markers!
- Map 4: Protect The Villages – Learn about specific enemy behaviors and 
specific defeat conditions! 
- Map 5: Defend The Island – Learn the ways of crucial timing and building 
up pressure in the map showcasing the ‘Reach a specific tile’ goal.  
To get in touch with the community, or to get directly in touch with the team, join
our discord!

Stay tuned for all the exciting news on Mahokenshi, and of course, join our community on Discord!

notes.title: Mahokenshi — MAJOR Content Update!
notes.notes:
Mahokenshi: The Designer's Guide 


Today, we are delighted to announce our biggest update by far.  Coming April 26th!

With these major additions, we wanted to give our community an immense thank you for all the support we have received since launch. We also wanted to show that we have been listening and sought to deliver on your biggest concerns- more content, save-states, and replayability. 

As a result, we’ve decided to implement three major changes: a brand new mission editor, the ability to save during missions, and a DLC pack with additional maps! 

The Mission Editor  

This exciting and innovative tool will allow players to create their own maps, giving the community endless possibilities.

With the Mission Editor update you will gain access to the Custom Missions menu, where you can conveniently select to browse downloaded or create your own maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/c69fa670356f4ac18eff131f1a15d3f7918ca092.gif

The Mission Editor will conveniently allow the ability to browse downloaded maps or create your own, allowing you to shape your own maps, one hex at a time! This can mean placing hordes of enemies, setting objectives, creating quests with rewards, and more. It’s an expansive tool directly derived from what the developers used to create the campaign.

After you’re done creating a map and you’re satisfied, you can simply upload it to the Steam workshop, making it available for everyone! The community can then download it and try it out via the in-game menus. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/97348092d56b1ed8715ed087769bcb561ecbf895.gif

Rating maps will be conveniently done via the workshop as well, giving players a clear way to filter based on their preferences.

From here on it’s up to the community to choose your adventure. Read comments, create missions, dive into 5-star rated maps from others, or be a pioneer and try the newly uploaded maps.

Mid-Mission Saving Update

One of the most requested features since launch has been the ability to save at any point during a mission, to allow for as much flexibility as possible while gaming. We saw and we have delivered! 

To ensure the most pleasant experience possible, this save feature will now be implemented in the game during any mission. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/541ae176b5ab71f8aa4791c25bda98e19707b713.gif

If you have to leave your computer you will be able to pick up your quest to save the Celestial Islands wherever you last left off. This should greatly ease flexibility with gameplay and make for a more enjoyable experience for all players!

The DLC pack: “Mahokenshi - The Designer's Guide”


This pack will include a handful of challenging maps functioning as a guide to show off the potential of the Mission Editor, helping creators to get started. 

These have been designed to help all players off the ground with learning the fundamentals of how to master our new editor. This should not only be both a great deal of fun, but an exciting challenge for all players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/bbb6d2a24a045113f4db5c38916480651cde25c6.png

Once again, thank you for all you have done to create the Mahokenshi community and we hope you enjoy all of this sensational new content.

Stay tuned for all the exciting news on Mahokenshi, and of course, join our community on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/57663fbcb3888c8fa1305f962073ed8e07587395.png

notes.title: Mahokenshi Release Date Reveal Trailer!
notes.notes:
Greetings Samurai,

As the presence of corruption grows stronger across the Celestial Islands, we need the Mahokenshi now more than ever. Thankfully, you will soon be able to take up your katana and drive back the forces of evil. We are excited to announce that Mahokenshi is releasing on January 24th! 

[previewyoutube=w4AL-okTr6Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're already a weathered samurai, welcome back! If this is your first time here: Mahokenshi is a unique blend of adventure, strategy, and deckbuilding gameplay. Choose the right samurai mage for every mission, build your deck out of dozens of powerful cards, and defeat the Oni King's hordes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717640/Mahokenshi/

notes.title: Mahokenshi - NEW Trailer + Release Window
notes.notes:
Samurai!

We're back with another update from the Celestial Islands. Last time, we mentioned that Mahokenshi would be releasing in 2023. We're excited to announce that we can now give you a more specific window, as Mahokenshi will be releasing in January 2023!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/e6ab717390649b5a166da318008b69239c62060e.png

Those of you who tested Mahokenshi in its earlier stages, or follow us on social media, may have already gotten a good peek at the gameplay of Ayaka, the Mahokenshi from the House of Ruby. In our brand new trailer, you can get a closer look at all four houses and their different playstyles.

[previewyoutube=bou48__WP9Y;full][/previewyoutube] 

So, which of the four Mahokenshi do you like most? You can expect some more clips of Sota from the House of Jade on our socials and Discord in the coming weeks, so make sure you're following us if you enjoy sneaky and poison-focused gameplay!

That's all from us today! Let us know your favorite samurai below, and join the community on Discord!
